verse_translation.google_trans: These and other kings are warriors and yours, O Pandava They go with the Gandharvas and the Yakshas and the pious people

verse_sans_lines: एते चान्ये महीपाला योधास्तव च पाण्डव

verse_translation.google_trans: Some of the men attained the path of the secrets Leaving the body, conquered heavens, by virtue, speech and intelligence.
Bhishma and Drona were great and Dhritarashtra and the earthly king Viratadrupada and both the conch and the north
Dhrishtaketujayasena and the king and Satyajit Duryodhana’s daughters and Shakuni and Saubala
Karnaputras and Vikranta and King Jayadratha Ghatotkachas and others and whatever others have not been mentioned
And the other kings mentioned there are glowing idols Tell me how many times they had in heaven

verse_sans_lines: स्वर्गे कालं कियन्तं ते तस्थुस्तदपि शंस मे

verse_translation.google_trans: Or is it the place of their eternal place there, O Blessed One Or at the end of the action, what do they attain, O best of men. I want to hear this, O Blessed One

verse_sans_lines: अन्ते वा कर्मणः कां ते गतिं प्राप्ता नरर्षभाः

verse_translation.google_trans: Thus addressed by the great sage Viprarshi Vyasa began to tell the king
O lord of men at the end of all actions to go Hear this secret of the gods, O king, O best of the Bharatas. What the mighty divine eyes spoke to the mighty
The sage is Purana, the Kauravas, Parashar, the great vow. The deep-minded is omniscient and the knower of all actions
The mighty Bhishma attained the great brightness of Vasun For there are only eight Vasavas, O Bharatarshabha
Then Drona entered Brihaspati, the best of the Angiras. Kritavarma, however, entered the Marutgana.
Sanatkumara entered Pradyumna as he had come Dhritarashtra reached the worlds of Dhanesh, the Durasadans.
Dhritarashtra with the illustrious Gandhari With his wives, Pandu went to the house of Mahendra.
Virata and Drupada are both Dhrishtaketu and the earthly Nishathakrurasamba and Bhanu Kampa Viduratha
Bhurisrava, Shala, Bhuri and the lord of the earth Ugrasena and Kansa and Vasudeva and the mighty
and the answer with his brother Shankha. They entered the best of all the gods, the best of men.
The mighty son of Soma was named Varcha. That Abhimanyu became the son of Nrishimha Phalguna
He fought with the Kshatriya dharma as no other man anywhere The righteous man entered the moon at the end of his actions

verse_sans_lines: स युद्ध्वा क्षत्रधर्मेण यथा नान्यः पुमान्क्वचित्

verse_translation.google_trans: Karna entered the sun, the father, the bull. Dwapara Shakuni reached Dhrishtadyumna and Pavakam
All the sons of Dhritarashtra are the demons who are strong The great souls, who were rich in weapons, went to heaven. The Kshatriyas entered Dharma and King Yudhisthira
Infinite Lord God entered the bottom He who holds a cow from yoga by the employment of his grandfather
Sixteen thousand women Vasudeva Parigraha Janamejaya, in time, drowned in the Saraswati. They also became apsaras and approached Vasudeva
The heroes who were killed in that great battle were great chariots Ghatotkacha and others all the gods and aksha
Duryodhanas and the demons are mentioned They have attained the best of all the worlds, O king.
The building and the wise of Mahendra and Kubera The men of Varuna entered the worlds of Varuna

verse_sans_lines: भवनं च महेन्द्रस्य कुबेरस्य च धीमतः

verse_translation.google_trans: I have told you all this in detail, O great light The whole character of the Kurus and the Pandavas, O Bharatha

verse_sans_lines: कुरूणां चरितं कृत्स्नं पाण्डवानां च भारत

verse_translation.google_trans: Hearing this, the king Janamejaya from the best of the twins He was astonished at the other sacrifices and in other sacrifices
Then the priests finished their actions The sword became pleased and released the serpents
Then he satisfied all the brahmins with alms They were also worshiped by the king and then went as they came
After dismissing the brahmins, the king was also Janamejaya Then he came back to the rock of the takshashila.
All this is told to you, Vaishampayana. By the command of Vyasa, the king's h was told in the snake sacrifice
This is the holy place called the history, if this is the best. The brahmin, the sage, the truthful, the truthful, the truthful.
By the omniscient and the law-knowing, the truthfulness of religion. By the transcendental and pure self-consciousness.
and the present in wealth and the Sankhya-yoga-wise. Seeing the divine eyes with the enlightened one who is not a single system
The fame of the great Pandavas in the world in the world and other Kshatriyas, rich in wealth and splendour.
He who hears this on the festival of the learned always on the festival Dhootapapama Jitasvargo goes to Brahmabhuti
He who recites this in the Shraddha at the end of his feet in the shraddha Inexhaustible food and drink are offered to the ancestors
Ahna yadenaḥ kurute indriyaiḥ or manapi The Mahabharata is called the Sandhya afterwards
In righteousness, in wealth, in desire and in liberation, O Bharata, Whatever is here is elsewhere and what is not here is nowhere

verse_sans_lines: धर्मे चार्थे च कामे च मोक्षे च भरतर्षभ

verse_translation.google_trans: This history of Jaya is to be heard by one who desires prosperity The king and the princess were pregnant and the woman
He who desires heaven attains heaven and he who desires victory attains victory The pregnant woman gets a son or a daughter with a lot

verse_sans_lines: गर्भिणी लभते पुत्रं कन्यां वा बहुभागिनीम्

verse_translation.google_trans: The Lord of Krishna Dvaipayanas in three years was uncoming The context of India was made for the sake of religion
Narada heard the gods, the black gods, the ancestors. The rakshasa, the yaksha, the parrot, the mortals, but the Vaishampayana.
History, this merit, great meaning, is the Vedas. If he recites the three varnas in front of the Brahmin
That man is freed from sin and attains fame here, Shaunaka He will go to the supreme perfection, there is no doubt about it here.

verse_sans_lines: स नरः पापनिर्मुक्तः कीर्तिं प्राप्येह शौनक

verse_translation.google_trans: From the study of India, even from the merit of studying. All sins are purified of the faithful

Thousands of parents and hundreds of sons and wives They go to the worlds and go to others.
Thousands of places of joy and hundreds of places of fear Day by day they enter the foolish and not the wise
I’ll bear the upper arm, and no one hears me. Why is he not served by religion and wealth and lust

verse_sans_lines: धर्मादर्थश्च कामश्च स किमर्थं न सेव्यते

verse_translation.google_trans: Never desire lust, nor greed; Eternal religion is in pleasure and pain, but in the eternal;The living entity is eternal, but the cause is eternal.

verse_sans_lines: न जातु कामान्न भयान्न लोभा;द्धर्मं त्यजेज्जीवितस्यापि हेतोः
नित्यो धर्मः सुखदुःखे त्वनित्ये; जीवो नित्यो हेतुरस्य त्वनित्यः

verse_translation.google_trans: He who rises in the morning and recites this Bharata Savitri He attains the fruits of India and attains the Supreme Brahman
As the ocean is the Lord and as the Himalayas Both are famous as Ratnanidhi and India
He who reads the Mahabharata with great concentration I have no doubt that he will go to the supreme perfection
